hypothesis: Previous NativeSoft first projected step has gradient dot delta=-.17054 but same-batch KL rises .01499 to .36118 and full KL .021116 to .26104. Standard full-objective line search can prevent such overshoot; whether a task-preserving yet recovery-resistant model exists is not established. No causal attribution of any new improvement solely to KL or optimizer.
objective: Complete800-view T4 teacher-output KL, optionally minus .005 times same-image fixed-scale CE/scale. Each of50 consecutive16-view batches has a single scale drawn once from original uniform rule seed0; identical scales across all closures. Both controls start unchanged parent. This fixes the sampled objective for standard line search; it is not identical to the earlier stochastic minibatch objective sequence.
differences_from_paper: Standard soft teacher targets and Trap2 scaling objective transfer; no official reproduction/new-method claim. Changes solver from stochastic AdamW to full fixed objective LBFGS and differentiates SVD/caps/affine coupling through parameterization. Both failed AdamW controls retained. Not a learning-rate,temperature,layer,rank or seed search.
computation: Two fixed full-objective solves;20 library iterations,max_eval30 with internal-line-search caveat.50 native minibatches per evaluation and50 scaled for joint. Original teacher/heads frozen, no construction real images. Full matching scores native checkpoint before/after. Final release only, no validation/test checkpoint selection.
evaluation: Freeze both final releases before any complete real-image evaluation. Same MNIST native,TA.5,AGA target/both,ProDistill64-per-task/100stepsperblock. Reuse all matched clean references. Failures fully reported; no natural-test tuning or promotion based only on synthetic scores.

references.method: Native/scaled CE objective; AdamW betas(.9,.98),eps1e-6; paperfull lr1e-4; scale.05..2 excluding.95..1.05; w(s)=1/s. Weightdecay0 to avoid changing SVD restrictions by regularizer.

references.section: 2: soft teacher targets,T^2 normalization; fixedT4 is inherited, not selected from this paper or current evaluation.

solver.note: Standard internal line search may evaluate beyond max_eval within one iteration; report actual evaluation count. No custom optimizer or manual rate sweep.
